description: Supplies Japanese and English labels to internal debug widgets by row name.

ID.technical: The lookup uses the UDataTable row name passed to SetDebugText. The native row also declares an ID property. SetDebugText stores its argument as DebugTextId after a successful lookup, and the available consumer leaves the row's ID member unread.

Ja.technical: When SetDebugText finds a row and bEnglish is false, it wraps Ja with FText::FromString and assigns the result to the text block.

En.technical: When SetDebugText finds a row and bEnglish is true, it wraps En with FText::FromString and assigns the result to the text block.

JaExplanation.simple: Japanese explanation text declared by the schema.
JaExplanation.technical: A Blueprint-editable FString. The reconstructed text-block lookup reads Ja or En. No direct consumer for JaExplanation was found in the available native source.

EnExplanation.simple: English explanation text declared by the schema.
EnExplanation.technical: A Blueprint-editable FString. The reconstructed text-block lookup reads En or Ja. No direct consumer for EnExplanation was found in the available native source.

usages.detail: Stores the weak table pointer and distributes a valid pointer to the registered debug text blocks.
Looks up the requested row and selects Ja or En. Falls back to displaying the requested row name when the table or row is unavailable.
Fans out language changes. Each text block re-runs the lookup for its stored key unless that key is SelfSetting.

notes: DebugTextTable is the widget's table property name. The available dataset supplies no matching asset or imported row list.
The native widget reads this as a UDataTable with FDataTableRow_DebugText.
